surface: plate_core.mcp_server, plate_core.mcp.registry, plate_core.mcp.arg_confinement, plate_core.mcp.path_confinement, plate_core.mcp.tool_definitions, plate_core.mcp.tools, plate_core.mcp.tool_profiles, plate_core.gh_actions_mark_implemented
summary: Unify MCP tools/list metadata in one registry module, dispatch the eight previously orphaned tools, confine every schema-discovered path-like argument at dispatch (including lists and symlinks), redact absolute paths in JSON-RPC errors, harden the stdio loop, and add table-driven confinement tests.
migration_impact: MCP hosts using plate_pr_verify repo_root must rely on the confined server checkout when run_tests is true; tools/list schema drops that parameter.
agent_notes: Use PLATE_MCP_TOOL_PROFILES=all for full registry tests. Path escapes outside .git root are rejected with PathConfinementError.
